title: core.identity.account.deleted v1
description: Emitted by CORE when a person deletes their own account (D-XR-13). The rows stay as tombstones, so this event is the only way consumers learn the person is gone: MOVE and MARKET purge their own copies of the person's data, keyed by the ids below. Neither consumer receives identity attributes beyond the ids - the display name is already scrubbed, and the event deliberately carries none. One person, one event: the deletion is idempotent, so a repeat of a committed deletion emits nothing (and over HTTP it cannot even arrive authenticated - the sessions are revoked).
